CONSTAN[---]ALVO, the seal is from the house of Constantine dating it to the early 4th century

An incomplete Roman lead alloy seal dating to the early 4th century AD. The obverse depicts a laureate bust facing right. The central image is surrounded by a circlular beaded border. The reverse depicts a central image or inscription surrounded by an inscription around the edge, the central motif is illegible. The inscription reads CONSTAN[---]ALVO, the seal is from the house of Constantine…
